page.notes: The index is printed in three columns with some entries partly illegible; the "Z." entries at the middle, the "Zollikon" and "Zuber" lines, and the numbers in the right column are uncertain. The "FINIS" line is set with a large ornamental N-like letter. The "Z." and "Zuber" readings are doubtful; the printed hand is ornamental, so some capitals may be misread.
